Senses.Explanation: Strenuous restless carrying-on, especially the exhausting busyness of those who keep laboring without settling the matter. Tian'an Sheng uses the expression in evening assembly to press the assembly's from-dawn-to-dusk toil against the turning-or-not examination of the pearl in the bowl. Baichi Xingyuan independently deploys it through independent direct small-address use.
